# Extract the time strings for Valentino Rossi and Ralf Waldmann
rossi_time = df.loc[df['Rider'] == 'Valentino Rossi', 'Time/Retired'].iloc[0]
waldmann_time = df.loc[df['Rider'] == 'Ralf Waldmann', 'Time/Retired'].iloc[0]

# Convert time strings to seconds for calculation
def time_to_seconds(time_str):
    if '+' in time_str:
        # Remove the '+' sign and any leading/trailing spaces
        time_str = time_str.replace('+', '').strip()
    # Check if the time is in minutes:seconds.milliseconds format
    if ':' in time_str:
        parts = time_str.split(':')
        minutes = int(parts[0])
        seconds_parts = parts[1].split('.')
        seconds = int(seconds_parts[0])
        milliseconds = int(seconds_parts[1]) if len(seconds_parts) > 1 else 0
        total_seconds = minutes * 60 + seconds + milliseconds / 1000
    else:
        # Handle cases like "38:04.730" (winning time without '+')
        parts = time_str.split('.')
        minutes_seconds = parts[0].split(':')
        minutes = int(minutes_seconds[0])
        seconds = int(minutes_seconds[1])
        milliseconds = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        total_seconds = minutes * 60 + seconds + milliseconds / 1000
    return total_seconds

rossi_seconds = time_to_seconds(rossi_time)
waldmann_seconds = time_to_seconds(waldmann_time)

# Calculate the difference in seconds
time_difference_seconds = waldmann_seconds - rossi_seconds

# Convert the difference back to a time string format (minutes:seconds.milliseconds)
def seconds_to_time_str(seconds):
    minutes = int(seconds // 60)
    remaining_seconds = seconds % 60
    # Format to three decimal places for milliseconds
    time_str = f"{minutes}:{remaining_seconds:06.3f}"
    return time_str

answer = seconds_to_time_str(time_difference_seconds)
